Leaflet 1.9.4 browser distribution, vendored from the `leaflet@1.9.4` npm
package (https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaflet/v/1.9.4). The package was downloaded
with npm's registry integrity verification. See LICENSE for the BSD license.

The public dashboard loads these local assets so a CDN outage or a mismatched
CDN stylesheet integrity attribute cannot leave Leaflet tiles unpositioned.
The images directory preserves the relative paths used by leaflet.css.
Project-detail GIS modules retain their existing assets and endpoints.
